models.title: Model connections
models.description: Connect your ChatGPT plan or use an API key to generate teaching material.
models.testSuccess: The model responded successfully. You can generate teaching material.
models.subscriptionDescription: Sign in with ChatGPT and allow EduForge to use your plan allowance on the consent screen. Availability depends on your plan and account permissions.
models.loopbackNote: Plan sign-in uses the local 127.0.0.1 address and returns to this page.
models.chooseModel: Choose a model available to your account
models.noModels: No available models have been loaded. Refresh the list or sign in again.
models.apiDescription: Enter a Chat Completions endpoint supporting structured output, a model, and your API key. The key field clears after submission.
models.modelPlaceholder: Enter a model name from your provider
models.sessionNote: API keys and sign-in credentials stay in backend memory. Reconnect after a backend restart. Testing sends a small model request and counts toward the daily generation limit.
models.loginSuccess: ChatGPT authorization completed. Choose a model and test the connection.
models.oauthDenied: ChatGPT authorization was canceled. You can sign in again.
models.oauthPermission: Permission to use your ChatGPT plan was not granted. Sign in again and allow plan usage.
models.oauthExpired: The sign-in attempt expired or could not be verified. Sign in again.
models.oauthFailed: ChatGPT sign-in could not be completed. Try again.
models.revocationPending: The local connection was cleared. Remote revocation was not confirmed. You can disconnect this app in ChatGPT settings.

errors.invalid_connection: Check the HTTPS endpoint, model, and API key.
errors.connection_forbidden: The settings request could not be verified. Reload the page.
errors.provider_unavailable: Check model settings, API key, or sign-in status and retry.
errors.plan_permission: Allow ChatGPT plan usage on the consent screen.
errors.connection_limit: The model usage or daily generation limit was reached. Try again later.
errors.connection_failed: The model connection could not be completed. Check settings and network access.
errors.body_too_large: The submitted settings are too long.
